fusions.name: Slow Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps wide, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Idle Prod
fusions.desc: Flicks a pebble that deals 4 damage, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Eventually Mended
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Eventual Rest
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
